title: Rehearsal, Retry, Safe Failure & Training/Project Integration

implementation_scope.purpose: Define deterministic read-only contracts for rehearsal attempts, retries, safe failure and training/project integration over the frozen ALP-01 through ALP-05 taxonomy, evidence and optional-practice contracts while preserving owner-system mutation authority.
authorized: explicit rehearsal identity, practice-space reference, participant, scope and provenance
retry lineage with stable attempt identity and deterministic attempt ordering
safe-failure projection in which rehearsal failure does not itself mutate canonical character, project, scene, achievement or reward state
explicit training marker and project learning evidence references tied to frozen ALP taxonomy families
read-only training/project integration references to Character Progression, Projects, World/Scene, GCL, ISE and MAL owner objects
authorized rehearsal observation projection with missing, hidden or unauthorized evidence remaining unknown
deterministic ordering and receipts independent of supplied rehearsal, attempt, owner-reference and evidence ordering
not_authorized: automatic XP, advancement, capability, achievement completion or reward grants from rehearsal, retry or failure
canonical penalties, injuries, resource loss, project mutation or world/scene mutation caused solely by safe-failure rehearsal outcomes
direct Character Progression, Reputation/Relationship/Faction, World/Scene, Project, GCL, ISE or MAL mutation
universal permission or unrelated capability gates
ALP-07 player/GM UX, accessibility, notification or recognition-history behavior
ALP-07 or later ALP behavior beyond explicit reserved references
provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment
